sourceFacts.fact: Each commandPluginRuntime call validates and freezes input then distinguishes typed4xx versus UnknownPluginAcknowledgementError per attempt. It does not own prior UI command outcome or merge multiple retry observations.
Validated accepted runtime ACK carries fixed registration/revision/change/exact enable tuple; consumer must reuse decoder and retain original input/key. Consumer does not create a second ACK codec.
Runtime mutation wraps revision/material/runner checks inside command idempotency helper; a subsequent read or error is not an original-command result query.
